notes: Fixed configured cap, not required actual occupancy/size. Internal boundary adds no wire enum. Written boundary tests are future implementation obligations, not executed proof. Fixed profile per #342 addendum; meaningful smaller profiles unsupported. Source-age/authentication constraints remain independent. Persistent floors/denials/receipts are never evicted to meet resident limits; no automatic retry, background refresh or coalesced waiter fanout. Smaller semantic grammar/constant bounds remain binding: canonical UUID, FND04 key ID1–64 ASCII, fixed issuer/profile/purpose, Ed25519 public key32 decoded bytes/43 unpadded base64url characters, uint64 up to20 decimal digits and nonnegative signed64 timestamp up to19 digits. These are representation rules, not replacement body budgets.
